关于超市的故事(A Story about the supermarket): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:米娅与汤姆的经历和小计划。
It takes twenty minutes to get to the supermarket by bike. Last Monday, Mia and Tom went to the supermarket. Tom's birthday is in November. For example, he wears shorts even in autumn.
Mia usually has chicken for breakfast. There are always many people at the cashier. The weather was cloudy that day. Also, a gift card saves guessing sizes.
Mia wrote about the day in the diary. They took many photos at the cashier. The supermarket is one of the best places in the city. For example, I was scared when the oil in the pan jumped.
Both of them like chicken and tea. Mia is reading a book about history. Mia hopes to visit Chengdu one day.
